basic_details.job_title: NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow (Electrical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Electrical Engineering Department of the National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut) is engaging 1 Junior Research Fellow on contract basis for 9 months in a research project sponsored by CPRI. The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA. The essential qualification is a B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering with a valid GATE/NET score. Applications go by email to [email protected], with a copy to [email protected]. They must be sent by 11 November 2026, and the offline interview is on 18 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications for the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow post are accepted by email only. They must be sent by 11 November 2026. The notice gives these steps:
Fill in the registration form given with the notice (as annexed).
Attach soft copies of your mark sheets and certificates supporting your academic qualification and experience.
All the soft copies may be combined into a single PDF document.
Email the application to [email protected], with a copy to [email protected].
Write the subject line "Application for Junior Research Fellow".
Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification and experience
No Objection Certificate from the employer, only for applicants already employed (government or any other organization), submitted at the time of interview
The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photograph submitted.

35 years (the notice marks the age limit as optional)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow notice prints the following eligibility conditions: Essential qualification: B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering with valid GATE/NET score. Desirable qualification: M. Tech in Electrical Engineering with GATE/NET qualified. Age limit: 35 years. The notice lists this as "Age Limit (optional)". It prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Relaxation for exceptional candidates: The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Applications for the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow post are accepted by email only. They must be sent by 11 November 2026. The notice gives these steps: Fill in the registration form given with the notice (as annexed). Attach the most recent CV. Attach soft copies of your mark sheets and certificates supporting your academic qualification and experience. All the soft copies may be combined into a single PDF document. Email the application to [email protected] , with a copy to [email protected] . Write the subject line "Application for Junior Research Fellow" . Duly filled registration form (as annexed) Most recent CV Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification and experience No Objection Certificate from the employer, only for applicants already employed (government or any other organization), submitted at the time of interview The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photograph submitted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: After the applications are shortlisted, eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the interview. The interview is scheduled for 18 November 2026 in offline mode. The notice does not mention the interview venue or reporting time. Applicants who are already working for the government or any other organization must bring a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer to the interview, together with the documents listed above. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow vacancies are there at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: There is 1 Junior Research Fellow position in the Electrical Engineering Department of NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering with a valid GATE/NET score. An M. Tech in Electrical Engineering with GATE/NET qualified is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as 35 years and marks it as optional.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the pay as Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: Fill in the annexed registration form and attach your recent CV and certificate copies, combined into a single PDF if you wish. Email it to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] by 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What subject line should the application email have?
faq.answer: The subject line must be "Application for Junior Research Fellow".

faq.question: Q9. How will the NIT Calicut JRF be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted, eligible candidates are notified by email, and they attend an offline interview on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is the NIT Calicut JRF post permanent, and is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the post is on contract basis for 9 months in a CPRI-sponsored research project. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
